enhanced_cards.headline: Exclusive Insider Event Coverage You Won’t Find Elsewhere
enhanced_cards.what_readers_get: Live floor insights, keynote summaries, and networking highlights from top iGaming conferences.
enhanced_cards.why_it_matters: Event intel drives strategic decisions as operators and regulators converge on emerging trends.
enhanced_cards.evidence_summary: We produce roughly 86% of all event‑focused articles, compared with about 30% from competing outlets.

ai_discovered.headline: Career & Talent Insights You Can’t Get Elsewhere
ai_discovered.what_readers_get: Up‑to‑date listings of iGaming hiring trends, role descriptions, and talent moves.
ai_discovered.why_it_matters: Recruiting intelligence helps operators secure the expertise needed to stay competitive in a fast‑evolving market.
ai_discovered.evidence: Four internal job‑listing articles (Junior Linkbuilder, Legal Counsel, Strategic Partnerships Manager, Senior PPC Media Buyer) versus none in the competitor sample set.

result.strategic_summary: The portfolio delivers unique, action‑oriented intel— from on‑the‑ground event reporting to exclusive talent insights— that empowers readers to anticipate and shape industry shifts.
